login.title: Credit lifecycle management
login.description: Manage applications, risk assessment, credits, payment schedules, and disbursements in one environment.

login.disclaimer: Demonstration implementation for technical assessment. This is not an official commercial product.

dashboard.description: Current status of managed applications and credits.

dashboard.noPendingDescription: New files will appear here when they require a decision.

form.title: Register application
form.description: Complete the required information. The estimated payment updates automatically.

disbursement.bankHelp: Select one of the enabled institutions.
